event: Those are unrelated local variables. Only coverage hits the real registers (coverage, not a check).

I found no test that verifies any of the five items, so the finding stands for all of them and I submitted a verified verdict.

- **What references the registers:** the real interrupt count and incr registers appear only in generated code and the coverage interface (`src/mci/coverage/mci_top_cov_if.sv`). The coverpoints there sample counter values but check nothing, so they can't fail a test.
- **Unrelated hits:** the `intr_count` matches in the integration test C files are an unrelated local variable, for example `src/integration/test_suites/smoke_test_wdt/smoke_test_wdt.c:28`.
- **Per item:** I found no check for the 1-cycle incr pulse (`cr_73c6e4152180`, `cr_81ffd1fa635f`), the rising-edge trigger (`cr_77c7ae0b431e`), the increment by 1 per event (`cr_7a8284f75705`), or saturation (`cr_84e8df210e83`).

My searches were text searches over the repo for the register and signal names. I did not trace the regression lists or open every test directory.
